title: Relief valve
object: DN25 spring-loaded safety relief valve in axial section
idea: A spring-set threshold with hysteresis: pop open, blow down, reseat
summary: The spring's preload over the seat area sets the opening pressure. Once the disc cracks open, gas fills the huddling chamber and acts on a larger area, so the valve pops to high lift and stays open until the pressure has fallen about 10 %, then snaps shut. A compressor refills the receiver and the cycle repeats, tracing the hysteresis loop in Diagram 1.
usedFor: Process safety training: set pressure, simmer, blowdown and chatter
Product documentation for safety valves to ISO 4126 / ASME VIII
Explaining back-pressure, load shedding and hysteresis thresholds in queues
